verdict.rationale: Wise Business clearly consolidates banking (multi-currency accounts, global payment details), cards, and payment sending/API into one platform, which covers 'banking' and part of 'spend'. However, there is no evidence of dedicated bill-pay/AP automation or spend-management features (approvals, budgets, expense categorization) that founders would need to fully replace those point solutions, and community reports show operational friction (account detail changes, account blocks) that undercut a seamless 'one platform' story. Missing for 10: dedicated bill pay/invoicing workflow, spend management/approval controls, and independent evidence of reliability at scale.
